name: 97071 · Woodburn, OR
findings: ZIP 97071 (Woodburn) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97071 (Woodburn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
